## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle anonymous text is a Buddhist ritual manual (*yí* 儀) for monastic *huáyán* services centred on the cosmological structure of the *[Avataṃsaka](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0010)*'s seven-place / nine-assembly teaching framework. The ritual invites the cosmic Vairocana Buddha and the bodhisattvas of the nine assemblies into the *bodhi-maṇḍa* (道場) for devotional offering and contemplative practice. The *hǎi yìn* "ocean-seal" reference is to the *[hǎi yìn sānmèi doctrine](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0113)*.

**Abstract**

The work is anonymous and undated; conventional scholarship places it broadly in the Tang-Sòng period of Chinese Buddhist liturgical literature. The bracket adopted here (800 – 1280) reflects this maximum window. The work is preserved in the Manji *Xù zàng jīng* (X1469) collection in the *Huáyán* liturgical-ritual section.
